name: generating-memes
title_zh: 298 个模板随叫随到，连 petpet 都能现做
tagline_zh: 不用打开网页找模板，命令行里搜、预览、生成一步到位。自带 298 个经典梗图，连 petpet、slap。
tagline_en: Skip the browser hunt—search, preview, and generate from 298 templates right in your terminal, including animated.
desc_en: Creates memes using the meme CLI with 298 templates. Generates, previews, searches, and lists meme templates. Use when user asks to make memes, create memes, generate memes, or mentions specific meme names like petpet, slap, hug, rub, etc.
why_zh: 它把 meme CLI 的完整能力包成 Skill，不用记命令参数，说人话就能调。模板库离线可用。
why_en: Wraps the full meme CLI into a natural-language Skill—no flags to memorize. Offline template library with.
limit_zh: 只认 meme CLI 支持的 298 个模板，超出范围会报错；需要本机已安装 meme CLI 且能联网下载模板。
limit_en: Only works with the 298 templates supported by meme CLI; requires meme CLI installed locally and internet for template downloads; outputs static.
title_en: 298 meme templates on call, even petpet on demand
